title: Understanding the Model
text: The model uses a linear regression approach with features for vegetables and types of meat. Adding a random feature can affect the model's variance.

title: Effect of Random Features
text: Adding a feature of random numbers between $$0$$ and $$1$$ can increase the model's variance because it introduces additional complexity without providing meaningful information.

title: Analyzing Variance
text: How does adding a random feature affect the variance of the model?
choices: It has no effect on the variance.

hintAnswer: It does not significantly affect the bias.
title: Analyzing Bias
text: How does adding a random feature affect the bias of the model?
choices: It does not significantly affect the bias.

title: Conclusion on Bias and Variance
text: Adding a random feature increases variance but does not significantly affect bias. This is because the random feature adds complexity without improving the model's ability to generalize.
